description: Change a person's account in a portal: their email address, login, first name, last name or phone. Pass only what the person asked to change; nothing else is touched. The answer says CHANGED (was → now) / UNCHANGED per item. A password is NEVER set here and never asked for in the chat: send_portal_user_password_letter mails the person a link to set their own.

login.description: The new login. Changing the email does not change the login.

name: update_portal_user
